name: Assault Angel Canon
source:
One day, Keiichi meets Canon unexpectedly, and "Despire" suddenly appears in front of them. "Despire" attacks Keiichi, and the two crystals appear from inside him. Keiichi is pursued by "Despire" since then, and Canon and her company fight against "Despire". But the girls gradually get involved in a series of insults....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090109130855/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006134]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
有一天，庆一意外地遇见了佳能，“Despire”突然出现在他们面前。“Despire”攻击圭一，两块水晶从他体内出现。庆一从此受到“Despire”的追求，佳能和她的公司则与“Despire”展开斗争。但女孩们却逐渐卷入一系列的侮辱之中……
